Results.ReviewText: Really wish this was manufactured in the United States. You would think for the price point on all Weber products they could be manufactured in the United States. I bought this grill to replace a Weber genesis that was made in the United States but I believe that grill was 30 years old.   I assumed this grill was U.S. made sadly it isn’t. I’m sure Weber has no interest in grills lasting 30 years anymore. Maybe that’s why they are no longer made in the United States, I suspect it has just as much to do with maximizing profits as anything.

Results.ReviewText: The grill itself is fine, it appears to be of good quality. The customer care service leaves a whole lot to be desired. While assembling the grill one of the studs that the left side grill table hinges up and down on simply popped out of the grill table. It can't be reinstalled into its position so the table can't swing up and down. After registering the grill I called the Customer Care number. After holding on for a while a person answered. Now this is when the whole Corona thing had gotten started and maybe all the customer service people had stayed home and they just had someone there to answer the phone, I don't know, but I soon started wondering if I had the right number. He made light of the pivot stud popping out of the table and really didn't know much about what I was talking about. He became frustrated and hung up on me. I then sent a email to Customer Care along while all the required information and a picture of the problem. Never got a response to my email but a few days later a package came to my house. It was a new left side table for my grill.
Results.Title: Caveat emptor!

Results.ReviewText: I have owned a few bbq grills in the past but never a Weber until now (always wanted to try one). Bought it during safer at home orders.  I am very pleased with the size, quality, and appearance (sapphire model). It heats up extremely fast and the cooking surface is the perfect size for a family of 3 or 4.  The ignition device is nice compared to other brands.  The cast iron, porcelain grates are solid.  They seem like they have a lot of miles to give.  And I like how the drip tray can be removed from the front.  Great grill that can easily get up to 600 + degrees F.
Results.Title: Spirit II e-210 - very pleased

44010001.Name: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
44010001.Description:
Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling. The compact open-cart design and the practical folding side table makes it fit even on small spaces, and you have all the basics you need to get familiar with gas grilling. So whether it’s a busy Monday or a relaxed Sunday – invite a couple of friends over, push the ignition and enjoy the special atmosphere that surrounds the grill.


 This product requires assembly.
